title: MCP Python SDK v2.2.0 changes Streamable HTTP and OAuth behavior
content: Version 2.2.0 changes redirect handling, expires idle legacy Streamable HTTP sessions, tightens OAuth issuer validation, and fixes outputSchema reference resolution. SignalHarness currently resolves mcp 2.1.1.

title: Resource allowlist check does not collapse dot segments
content: Open issue #3464 reports that check_resource_allowed can treat paths such as /api/../admin as under /api. The issue is labeled as affecting both v1 and v2 lines.

title: MCP 2026-07-28 specification moves to a stateless protocol core
content: The 2026-07-28 MCP specification retires initialize/initialized and Mcp-Session-Id, makes requests self-describing, adds header-based routing and cacheable list responses, and updates Tier 1 SDKs with migration guidance.

title: Typer 0.27.0 updates metavar printing
content: Typer 0.27.0 lists one breaking change: metavar printing was updated. SignalHarness currently resolves Typer 0.26.7 and uses Typer for its CLI.

title: Pydantic 2.13.5 maintenance fixes
content: Pydantic 2.13.5 fixes validator reuse with plugins, missing garbage-collector traversal fields, and smart-union validated-field counting. SignalHarness currently resolves Pydantic 2.13.4.

title: FastAPI 0.141.1 fixes app.frontend dependency background tasks and headers
content: FastAPI 0.141.1 fixes background tasks and headers from dependencies in app.frontend. SignalHarness already resolves FastAPI 0.141.1 and does not rely on this as a newly pending upgrade.

title: FastAPI 0.140.13 fixes status codes for SSE and JSONL streams
content: FastAPI 0.140.13 fixes status_code being ignored for SSE and JSONL streaming endpoints. SignalHarness uses SSE but already resolves the later FastAPI 0.141.1 release.

title: Uvicorn 0.52.4 fixes duplicate Date headers in WebSocket handshakes
content: Uvicorn 0.52.4 fixes duplicate Date headers in accepted WebSocket handshakes using the websockets-sansio implementation. SignalHarness already resolves 0.52.4 and its primary live stream is SSE.

title: Rich 15.0.0 drops Python 3.8 support
content: Rich 15.0.0 is a major release because Python 3.8 support was dropped. SignalHarness already resolves Rich 15.0.0 and requires Python 3.10 or newer.

title: LangGraph 1.2.11 exposes trace_policy and updates checkpoint behavior
content: LangGraph 1.2.11 exposes trace_policy on add_node and includes checkpoint-related fixes and conformance work. LangGraph is a monitored ecosystem project and competitor, not a direct SignalHarness dependency.

title: OpenAI Agents Python 0.21.0 adds provider-neutral testing APIs
content: Version 0.21.0 adds provider-neutral deterministic testing APIs, OpenAI Python v3 compatibility, and reliability improvements around RunState and MCP lifecycle handling. The release states there is no known breaking SDK behavior change.

title: OpenAI Agents Python 0.20.0 changes its default model and MCP dependency integration
content: Version 0.20.0 changes the SDK's implicit default model and includes a potentially breaking MCP dependency migration for applications with customized local HTTP transports. SignalHarness does not depend on openai-agents-python directly.

title: AutoGen enters maintenance mode and points new users to Microsoft Agent Framework
content: The AutoGen repository now states that AutoGen is in maintenance mode, will receive no new features or enhancements, and is community managed; new users are directed to Microsoft Agent Framework. AutoGen is a tracked SignalHarness competitor.

title: CallToolResult structuredContent may not match aliased outputSchema
content: Open issue #3467 reports that CallToolResult structuredContent is not alias-normalized to match outputSchema and identifies the current stable 2.x release line. This can make clients reject otherwise server-produced structured tool payloads.

title: MCP v1 Streamable HTTP unresolved-request bug is already fixed on 2.x
content: Open issue #3441 requests a v1.x backport for a Streamable HTTP client bug where an SSE response stream could end without resolving a request. The issue explicitly says the bug is fixed on 2.x; SignalHarness currently resolves mcp 2.1.1.
